**Notes from The Critic:**
- Six weeks, 23 dishes rated; 19 of 23 at 4★+. Three "Cook again: No" verdicts now on file (Cuban pork chops, Lomo Saltado, Greek meatball bowls).
- **NEW yogurt-fatigue signal — important.** Sean's Greek Meatball note: "the greek yogurt in every recipe is starting to get old." This is a counter-signal to the standing "tangy yogurt over heavy cream" preference: yogurt is loved as an occasional sauce base (butter chicken, shawarma), but Sean is tiring of it appearing week after week. Recommendation to the Chef: cap Greek/plain yogurt-forward sauces (tzatziki, yogurt marinades, yogurt crema) at ~1 per week; vary sauce bases. The yogurt-for-cream swap is still a win when used sparingly — the problem is frequency, not yogurt itself.
- Protein-format signal, not protein signal: pork chops missed (3★/No) while ground pork scored 4★; Lomo Saltado missed while every other beef format is 5★; Greek meatballs missed on the yogurt/tzatziki format while chicken is otherwise 5★. Judge formats and sauces, not just proteins.
- Bulgogi's 5★ makes Korean a two-dish winner (bulgogi 5★, gochujang 4★). Salmon tacos push salmon to 4.7★ across three prep styles and prove Sean likes the fish-taco format.
- Mississippi Pot Roast is now 5★ twice — a locked-in permanent favorite; the "4 meals of leftovers" value is a repeat selling point.
- Emerging candidate hard-dislike for Standing Preferences: whole pork chops (one data point — still flag rather than write in).
- Garlic-butter chicken + broccoli remains 2-for-2 at 5★; adopt Sean's mods (pasta added, broccoli par-boiled) into the recipe card next time it's served.
- Difficulty estimates remain accurate — still zero "harder than described" across 23 dishes (bulgogi even came in easier).
- Never-cooked early-reuse pool: Cajun Honey-Butter Shrimp Bowls (dropped 06-29). Lemon-Garlic Butter Scallops was used week 07-20 (no longer in the pool). No-repeat window does not apply to dropped-never-cooked dishes.
- Carry-forward operational reminder (week 06-08): shopping list previously omitted honey, sesame seeds, rice wine vinegar. No new list-gap reports since.

## Recipe Recycling Rules
*The Chef reads these when building the weekly menu.*

- ★★★★★ (5): Recycle every 3–4 weeks
- ★★★★ (4): Recycle every 5–6 weeks
- ★★★ (3): Recycle only if explicitly carried over
- ★★ (2) or below: Do not recycle unless Sean requests it
- "Cook again: No" overrides star rating — do not recycle regardless of score
